title: Modal
description: Full-screen native overlay for authored content with server-controlled visibility and dismissal.

blocks.text:
Modal presents authored content in a full-screen native overlay. PHP owns
whether the overlay is requested; each platform owns cover or dialog chrome
and motion.

Use Alert Dialog for a single acknowledgement. Use
Confirmation Dialog for a confirm/cancel decision.
Use Bottom Sheet for a panel that slides up from the
bottom.

<firstlight:modal
    :visible="$showingAccount"
    a11y-label="Account details"
    @dismiss="closeAccount"
>
    <native:text class="text-lg font-semibold text-theme-on-surface">Account details</native:text>
</firstlight:modal>
The dismiss handler should set $showingAccount to false.

The visible title is ordinary text styled as a heading. Mobile UI text has no
heading role yet, so screen readers announce the surface by its a11y-label.

blocks.label: visible
blocks.text:
Accepted type: bool
Purpose: Server-controlled presentation request. Defaults to closed.

blocks.label: dismissible
blocks.text:
Accepted type: bool
Purpose: When true, native close, back, and outside dismissal are enabled. Defaults to the upstream native default of true. The dismissable alias is accepted.

blocks.label: a11y-label
blocks.text:
Accepted type: non-empty string
Purpose: Accessible name for the presented surface.

blocks.label: a11y-hint
blocks.text:
Accepted type: non-empty string
Purpose: Supplementary screen-reader guidance.

blocks.label: class
blocks.text:
Accepted type: string
Purpose: External EDGE layout utilities.

@dismiss is required. It runs when the user closes the overlay. Set the
bound visibility property to false in that handler. Dismiss handlers must
be safe to run more than once because the delegated iOS cover can also notify
PHP when a programmatic close is published.

There is no overlay @press, native:model, or detent API. Actions belong
on child controls.

Modal is an adapter over Mobile UI modal. iOS uses SwiftUI
.fullScreenCover; Android uses a Material full-screen dialog. Theme tokens
own surface colour. Close controls, when shown, use the native Close name.
